s.n: Burnt toast soldiers with soft eggs
s.note: Andy burns his birthday toast. Brown butter toast fingers and runny yolks.
s.how: Melt the butter and cook until it smells nutty and turns golden brown, then pour into a bowl. Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 6 minutes for runny yolks. Toast the bread dark at the edges, brush heavily with the brown butter and cut into soldiers. Sit the eggs in cups, take the tops off and scatter salt and chives over the toast.

s.note: Franks with seven toppings dragged through the garden. Norris chases Ray through Chicago.
s.how: Simmer the franks in water until hot through, about 6 minutes. Steam or warm the rolls so they stay soft. Tuck in the franks and add mustard, relish and onion. Add tomato wedges, a pickle spear and two peppers to each, and finish with celery salt.

m.note: Ray calls on Damballa as he dies. Citrus-braised crisp pork and spicy slaw.
m.how: Toss the pork with the orange and lime juice, garlic, onion, thyme, chilli and salt and leave for 20 minutes. Tip into a pot with water to just cover and simmer until tender and most of the liquid has gone. Mix the cabbage and carrot with the vinegar, a pinch of chilli and salt for the pikliz. Cook the rice with the beans and a pinch of salt. Fry the drained pork in hot oil until crisp at the edges and serve with the rice and pikliz.

m.note: Andy wanted a Good Guy so badly. Three-cheese bake with a crunchy top.
m.how: Boil the macaroni until just short of tender and drain. Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Stir in the mustard, cheddar and Gruyere, fold through the pasta and tip into a baking dish. Scatter the panko and parmesan over and bake at 200C until golden and bubbling.

w.note: Maggie digs into the birthday cake. Vanilla sponge with rainbow sprinkles.
w.how: Beat 250g butter with the sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs and vanilla. Fold in the flour, milk and sprinkles and divide between two lined 20cm tins. Bake at 175C until a skewer comes out clean, then cool. Beat 200g butter with the icing sugar and a splash of milk until fluffy. Sandwich and cover the cakes, shower with sprinkles and add 6 candles.

d.note: Orange juice poured by Andy. A sparkling brut mimosa.
d.how: Pour 100ml orange juice into each of 4 chilled flutes. Top slowly with the sparkling wine.
